As of quarter end, CareTrust reported Net Debt-to-Annualized Normalized Run Rate EBITDA of 1.4x, which is below the Company's target leverage range of 4.0x to 5.0x, and a net debt-to-enterprise value of approximately 8.5%.

The Company increased its 2026 guidance midpoints, raising the low end of its Normalized FFO and Normalized FAD estimates, and now projects net income attributable to CareTrust of approximately $1.50 to $1.51 per share, Normalized FFO of approximately $2.08 to $2.09 per share, and Normalized FAD of approximately $2.04 to $2.05 per share.
Bunker commented, “The midpoints of our updated Normalized FFO and Normalized FAD guidance represent increases of 18.5% and 16.2%, respectively, over 2025 results.
With leverage well below our target range and multiple levers across our capital toolkit, we are well positioned to keep funding growth at our current pace."
